title: Combinatorial slicing problems of polytopes: How (not) to reconstruct a polytope from its slices
summary: We study combinatorial aspects of hyperplane sections of polytopes, focusing on how much the combinatorics of the sections determines the combinatorics of the original polytope. We show that, in general, combinatorial information about the sections is not enough to determine even the $f$-vector of the polytope. In contrast, for sufficiently generic simple polytopes, the function recording the number of vertices of each central section determines the full combinatorial type. We organize different combinatorial slicing properties into hierarchies, separately for affine and central sections,…
